title: ME60422: Acoustics And Noise Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Wave equation, spherical and plane waves, transmission of energy in a fluid,
near far and reverberation field, harmonic motion, SDOF systems, Forced
Vibrations, Vibration of String and Plates, Spectral analysis concepts, Combing
Sources, Sound Fields, Working with sound field, time and frequency domain
analysis, fourier series concepts, octave bands, microphones, sound level
meters, accelerometers, FFT analysers, noise source characterization, source
ranking, noise control effectiveness, natural frequency, frequency response
concepts, transmission loss and mass law, barrier theory, enclosure, muffler,
damping, sound absorbing material, insertion loss, sound intensity, noise
control case studies in automobiles and plant machineries.
